meta.title: Enable bench-mode in Elixir transpiler
meta.body_summary: Add bench-mode to Elixir transpiler: wrap main in benchmark block under MOCHI_BENCHMARK flag, record results in Rosetta table, and regenerate 100-doors-2 output with metrics.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added bench-mode flag to Elixir transpiler; merged instantly by author with no reviews, including updated Rosetta benchmark output.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 977 changed lines across 7 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, concentrated in auto-generated output and documentation (ROSETTA.md and .out). It fits a self-contained feature addition to the transpiler, merged immediately by the author without external review.

review_details.performance_claim: Add benchmarking capability to Elixir transpiler output for tracking performance in Rosetta tasks.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a conditional benchmark wrapper and updating documentation within an existing transpiler is within agent capabilities; merge was instantaneous with no external review required.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes a specific test command and regenerated benchmark output, allowing reproduction of the benchmarking feature.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression identified; PR added new feature.

core_change_summary.description: Added benchMain option to Elixir transpiler so that 'main' can be wrapped in a benchmarking block when MOCHI_BENCHMARK=true. Updated Rosetta progress table format and regenerated 100-doors-2 Elixir output with benchmark metrics.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most of the changed lines are auto-generated Rosetta documentation and output regeneration; the core transpiler logic change is only 11 lines in transpiler.go.
change_trajectory: Single commit (c24bb42e) adds benchMain option to transpiler, updates Rosetta progress table format, and regenerates Elixir output with benchmark metrics.

collaboration_trajectory: Author created PR with single commit and self-merged immediately; no review or collaboration occurred.
